description:
Reads a public web page and returns its title and main text as clean plain text (menus, scripts and ads removed), in pages of up to 50,000 characters.
Use when: you need the content of an article, a documentation page, a blog post or any public page.
Not for: pages that need a login; PDFs (use the Faceabot PDF tool).
Example: {"url":"https://example.com"}

url.description: Public https address of the page

name: read_web_page
title: Read a web page
